# Praxia

> Freelance PPC consultant and measurement specialist based in Manchester, UK, working with B2B and lead-generation businesses across the UK. One-off, fixed-price projects. No retainers, no agency markup. Contact: info@praxia.uk

## What I do

- Microsoft Ads for B2B: full account builds, LinkedIn profile targeting, UET tracking, offline conversion import
- Google Ads: builds, restructures, technical fixes, large-scale changes through the Google Ads API
- Conversion tracking and measurement: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Consent Mode v2, server-side tagging, checkout and purchase tracking with real order values, custom conversions
- Offline conversion pipelines: GCLID and MSCLKID capture into the CRM, import back to Google and Microsoft
- Marketing data and reporting automation: scheduled collection from ad platforms, GA4, CRMs and public web sources, normalised into the report a team already reads, with per-source health checks and stale-data warnings
- Competitor price monitoring and tracking: daily collection from comparison sites and public pages, normalised and ranked, built once with no subscription
- PPC audits and diagnostics with a prioritised written report
- Conversion-focused landing page builds

## Facts

- Based in Manchester, England. Works remotely with clients anywhere in the UK.
- Solo practitioner: the person you speak to is the person who does the work.
- Does not offer monthly PPC management retainers.
- Every project ends with documentation the client owns.
